principles: Severity estimates potential impact, not exploitability.
Confidence estimates how strongly a simple textual heuristic matches; test files reduce confidence except for likely real credentials.
The CLI implements only rules marked implemented_by_cli. Other entries are human-review guidance, not an automated promise.

patterns.pattern: credential-like assignment or recognized token prefix
patterns.message: Hard-coded credential-like value detected; value is not included in report.
patterns.fix: Remove and rotate if exposed; use a secret manager or environment-based configuration.

patterns.pattern: SQL keyword on an added line plus concatenation/interpolation marker
patterns.fix: Use parameterized queries or safe ORM query construction.

patterns.message: Mutable default argument may be shared across calls.
patterns.fix: Use None and initialize a fresh value inside the function.

patterns.pattern: loop followed within five added lines by an execute/fetch/query call
patterns.message: Possible repeated I/O inside a loop.
patterns.fix: Inspect the call path; batch requests if there is one query per item.

patterns.pattern: time.sleep on an added line within an async function scope visible in the added lines
patterns.message: Blocking sleep may stall an async event loop.
patterns.fix: Use an async wait or move blocking work out of the event loop.

patterns.pattern: unbounded read() or readlines() on an added line
patterns.message: A full read may load a large resource into memory.
patterns.fix: Stream or process bounded chunks if input size is not controlled.

patterns.pattern: nested conditional depth greater than three
patterns.message: Deep conditional nesting may reduce readability.
patterns.fix: Consider guard clauses or smaller functions.

patterns.pattern: numeric literal lacking nearby domain context
patterns.fix: Use a named constant when it improves clarity.

patterns.pattern: public function without a docstring in full-file context
patterns.message: Public API documentation may be missing.
patterns.fix: Document purpose, parameters, return values, and exceptions where useful.

patterns.pattern: redirect uses untrusted input without allowlist
patterns.message: A redirect may use unvalidated external input.
patterns.fix: Validate targets against a strict allowlist.
